hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); d="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; case "$f" in "$d"/*.rs) git -C "$d" ls-files --error-unmatch "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || rustfmt --edition 2021 "$f";; "$d"/app/*.js|"$d"/app/*.jsx|"$d"/app/*.json|"$d"/app/*.css) cd "$d/app" && pnpm exec vp fmt --write "$f" >/dev/null;; esac; exit 0
